I'm a big fantasy fan. For a long time I was a Tolkien fanboy and would have answered with Lord of the Rings closely followed by The Silmarillion immediately. Two years ago, however, I got into a series that completely changed my view of the genre, a series that created something as great as Tolkien had when defining fantasy, but without being a copy cat - it's a series that's in the spirit of Tolkien's masterpieces while not using any of the cliches he had created. The Stormlight Archive is two books strong so far, and it's anticipated to be a 10-book series. Both are filled with amazing world-building, intricate character development, and exciting plot. In addition, it's the first book I've seen in a long time that incorporates illustrations as well as a good ol' story book would. If you're a fantasy fan, you definitely should at least consider jumping on the Brandon Sanderson hypetrain.
